Subject: SIG intake — request for onboarding/training samples

Hi Rishi,

We're kicking off the SIG intake for Redwood's personnel controls. To complete the assessment we need a short sample dataset from onboarding and offboarding controls: (1) anonymized training completion transcripts for a rolling 12-month window, (2) redacted background check confirmations (name replaced by unique id), and (3) a leaver timeline for individuals who left in the last 18 months showing deprovision timestamps and manager sign-off.

Could you provide: an export (CSV) of training completion events, a redacted BG confirmation bundle (PDF) and a leaver timeline (CSV)? Preferably compressed; if any of this requires approvals, let me know the expected timeline.

Thanks,
Elena
Veritas Audit — Senior Controls Analyst
elena.gomez@veritas-audit.com
attachments: request-form-SIG.pdf (pdf)

Hi Elena,

Following up — HR exported the requested artifacts and applied our standard redaction. Attached:
- onboarding_training_2025-07_2026-06.csv (columns: user_id, course_id, completion_date, completion_status)
- bg_confirmations_redacted_2026-07.pdf (each record shows 'candidate_id', 'verification_date', 'vendor_reference')

- Timestamps are in UTC; deprovision records include time and source (AD/Okta).
